title: Navy Blue Account: Overdraft Protection and Fees
summary: This document explains Navy Blue Account overdraft options and fees: an overdraft fee is $0.00 per occurrence when a covered transaction settles into a negative available balance, and overdraft protection via a linked eligible account transfers funds automatically with a $0.00 transfer fee. It also covers how to change preferences in online/mobile banking and when overdraft fees don’t apply (declined transactions or fully covered shortfalls), plus dispute/reversal handling case-by-case.
faqs: What overdraft fee will I be charged if my Navy Blue Account goes negative?
How does overdraft protection via a linked eligible account work?
